name: industrial-edge-digital-twin
description: Deterministic heated-tank digital twin with a C++ engine, typed edge gateway, MQTT telemetry, and accessible HMI.

scripts.build: pnpm run build:gateway && pnpm run build:hmi
scripts.start:test: cross-env NODE_ENV=test TWIN_COMMAND_TOKEN=local-demo-token PORT=8080 node gateway/dist/main.js
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p gateway/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p gateway/test/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p hmi/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p hmi/test/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.validate:web: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm symbols:check && pnpm repository:check
